label: Aspect ratio
intent: The frame is cropped to 4:3. Light: crop marks draw in above and below the frame where the new 4:3 edges will be, then both side walls slam in to them, knock back a little and seat; the diagonal follows the corners, and the marks fade once the walls sit under them. Strong: the marks draw in while the wide frame stretches out against them, then the walls slam in and seat in two decaying beats. The frame stays 4:3. The reverse retracts the marks while the walls widen back to 16:9 and knock once on arrival.

frame.//: v1 frame: 23 x 13, corner 2.2; crop 0 -> 1 narrows it 3 units each side to v1's end (17 x 13)

tick-t.//: hidden at rest: a crop mark above the new left edge, drawn downward toward it

tick-b.//: hidden at rest: a crop mark below the new left edge, drawn upward toward it

reverse.//: by hand: the walls wait for the marks to show, widen, and knock once on arrival (auto would replay the bounce as a false start)
